verdict.rationale: The skills are distributed as repository files that install locally into agents. The README documents validating an unpublished local checkout through a local marketplace path, and a Nix flake builds the portable layout, so users can run the skill bundle from their own copy without a vendor-hosted service. Several things are not shown: the evidence never states an open-source license, never addresses self-hosting explicitly, and never shows whether the `yy` CLI and YYLO Ledger backend the skills depend on can run fully self-hosted. Missing for 10: explicit license/openness evidence, self-hosting documentation for the Ledger/CLI backend, independent corroboration of a fully local deployment.
